parsed.explanation: Step 3 correctly computes (alpha,beta) -> (min(alpha,beta), |alpha-beta|), but the only justification of gcd-preservation is the displayed divisibility equivalence followed by "(standard; details omitted)" and the bare assertion "In all cases $G_p$ is invariant" — no proof of either direction, and no handling of the equal or zero valuation cases, nor of why the unchanged coordinates keep the full-tuple gcd. The summary section only repeats the assertion ("which preserves gcd's"), so nothing is established elsewhere. The gap is one sentence wide (t | alpha, beta iff t | min and t | |alpha-beta|, since max = min + |alpha-beta|), hence repair_distance = sentence.
